mentions.name: MyVivaldy
mentions.description: A clinic business operating system for the healthcare industry, described as SAP made specifically for a clinic. It evolved from a simple reservation and encounter service into a full-fledged clinic OS serving employees and patients, with features rapidly prototyped with AI assistance while meeting healthcare regulatory requirements such as FHIR v4 interoperability.
mentions.source_excerpt: Hi, i have been working on https://myvivaldy.com, it's my clinic/business OS in healthcare industry (is this what the cool kids say nowadays?), Id say it is like SAP made just for this clinic OS.
mentions.author: sawirricardo
